issues.description: Documented extraction/demo path requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files that are absent from the repo.
End-to-end test currently fails from a clean checkout because it depends on the missing story corpus.
Default stories_dir points at data/stories, which exists as an empty directory and makes the default run unusable.
Validation builds the backend from CLI config instead of verifying it matches the vector manifest, allowing wrong-backend crashes or invalid results.
Preference validation loads vectors without checking manifest/backend/dimension compatibility before scoring activations.
HF preference scoring assumes ' good' and ' bad' are meaningful single-token labels and uses only the first token if they are not.
HuggingFace model/tokenizer loading is unpinned, making full-backend runs non-reproducible across upstream model revisions.
The installed console script is packaged without config.yaml, run_demo.sh, or data assets, so default CLI usage only works from the repo root.
Config loading has no semantic validation for required fields, empty emotion lists, topic counts, or missing data paths.
Extraction calls min/max on start_positions without guarding empty story sets, producing an unhelpful crash for invalid configs.
pca_components_for_variance(threshold=0) still returns and removes one principal component instead of zero.
Elo computation is order-dependent because ratings are updated sequentially over pair combinations.
